import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import re
import secrets
import sys
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from linkvault.clock import format_ts, parse_ts

MAX_BODY = 8192
SLUG_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}\Z")


class ApiError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status, code, message, headers=None, close=False):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status, self.code, self.message = status, code, message
        self.headers, self.close = headers or {}, close


class RateLimiter:
    """Fixed 60s windows per token hash; request limit+1 onward is rejected."""

    def __init__(self, limit):
        self.limit = limit
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._counts = {}

    def hit(self, token_hash, now):
        """Count a request; return None if allowed, else Retry-After seconds."""
        start = now - now % 60
        with self._lock:
            for k in [k for k, (w, _) in self._counts.items() if w != start]:
                del self._counts[k]
            count = self._counts.get(token_hash, (start, 0))[1] + 1
            self._counts[token_hash] = (start, count)
        return start + 60 - now if count > self.limit else None


class LinkVaultServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    block_on_close = False

    def __init__(self, store, clock, admin_key, rate_limit, fake_clock_enabled, port=0):
        super().__init__(("127.0.0.1", port), Handler)
        self.store = store
        self.clock = clock
        self.admin_key = admin_key
        self.limiter = RateLimiter(rate_limit)
        self.fake_clock_enabled = fake_clock_enabled

    @property
    def port(self):
        return self.server_address[1]


def make_server(store, clock, admin_key, rate_limit, fake_clock_enabled, port=0):
    return LinkVaultServer(store, clock, admin_key, rate_limit, fake_clock_enabled, port)


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), format % args), file=sys.stderr)

    def __getattr__(self, name):
        if name.startswith("do_"):
            return self._dispatch
        raise AttributeError(name)

    do_GET = do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = do_HEAD = do_OPTIONS = (
        lambda self: self._dispatch())

    # ---- responder ----
    def _respond(self, status, obj=None, headers=None):
        body = b""
        out = list(headers.items()) if headers else []
        if status in (204, 302):
            out.append(("Content-Length", "0"))
        else:
            body = json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("utf-8")
            out += [("Content-Type", "application/json"), ("Content-Length", str(len(body)))]
        self.send_response(status)
        for k, v in out:
            self.send_header(k, v)
        self.end_headers()
        if self.command != "HEAD" and body:
            self.wfile.write(body)

    def _error(self, e):
        headers = dict(e.headers)
        if e.close:
            headers["Connection"] = "close"
            self.close_connection = True
        self._respond(e.status, {"error": {"code": e.code, "message": e.message}}, headers)

    # ---- body ----
    def _content_length(self):
        raw = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        if raw is None:
            return 0
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", raw.strip()):
            raise ApiError(400, "invalid_request", "invalid Content-Length", close=True)
        return int(raw)

    def _read_body(self):
        n = self._content_length()
        if n > MAX_BODY:
            raise ApiError(413, "payload_too_large", "body too large", close=True)
        self._body_read = True
        return self.rfile.read(n) if n else b""

    def _drain(self):
        """Keep the connection in sync after an early error."""
        if self._body_read:
            return
        try:
            n = self._content_length()
        except ApiError:
            self.close_connection = True
            return
        if n > MAX_BODY:
            self.close_connection = True
        elif n:
            self._body_read = True
            self.rfile.read(n)

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_json(raw):
        try:
            obj = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), parse_constant=_reject_constant)
        except (ValueError, RecursionError):
            raise ApiError(400, "invalid_json", "body is not valid JSON")
        if not isinstance(obj, dict):
            raise ApiError(400, "invalid_json", "body must be a JSON object")
        return obj

    # ---- routing ----
    def _route(self, method, path):
        """Return (name, slug, kind, parse_json) or None. kind: none|bearer|admin."""
        fixed = {
            ("GET", "/healthz"): ("healthz", "none", False),
            ("POST", "/v1/tokens"): ("tokens", "admin", False),
            ("GET", "/v1/links"): ("list", "bearer", False),
            ("POST", "/v1/links"): ("create", "bearer", True),
        }
        if self.server.fake_clock_enabled:
            fixed[("POST", "/v1/admin/clock")] = ("clock", "admin", True)
        hit = fixed.get((method, path))
        if hit:
            return hit[0], None, hit[1], hit[2]
        if path.startswith("/v1/links/"):
            slug = path[len("/v1/links/"):]
            if SLUG_RE.match(slug):
                if method == "GET":
                    return "get", slug, "bearer", False
                if method == "DELETE":
                    return "delete", slug, "bearer", False
            return None
        if method == "GET" and path.startswith("/") and SLUG_RE.match(path[1:]):
            return "resolve", path[1:], "none", False
        return None

    def _dispatch(self):
        self._body_read = False
        try:
            self._handle()
        except ApiError as e:
            self._error(e)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("internal error: %r" % (e,), file=sys.stderr)
            try:
                self._error(ApiError(500, "internal", "internal server error"))
            except Exception:
                self.close_connection = True
        try:
            self._drain()
        except Exception:
            self.close_connection = True

    def _handle(self):
        srv = self.server
        now = srv.clock.now()
        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
        route = self._route(self.command, path)
        if route is None:
            raise ApiError(404, "not_found", "not found")
        name, slug, kind, wants_json = route

        token_hash = None
        if kind == "bearer":
            auth = self.headers.get("Authorization", "")
            if not auth.startswith("Bearer ") or not auth[7:]:
                raise ApiError(401, "unauthorized", "missing or invalid token")
            token_hash = hashlib.sha256(auth[7:].encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
            if not srv.store.token_exists(token_hash):
                raise ApiError(401, "unauthorized", "missing or invalid token")
            retry = srv.limiter.hit(token_hash, now)
            if retry is not None:
                raise ApiError(429, "rate_limited", "rate limit exceeded",
                               headers={"Retry-After": str(retry)})
        elif kind == "admin":
            given = self.headers.get("X-Admin-Key", "")
            if not hmac.compare_digest(given.encode("utf-8"), srv.admin_key.encode("utf-8")):
                raise ApiError(401, "unauthorized", "invalid admin key")

        raw = self._read_body()
        body = self._parse_json(raw) if wants_json else None

        if name == "healthz":
            self._respond(200, {"status": "ok"})
        elif name == "tokens":
            token = "lv_" + secrets.token_hex(16)
            srv.store.add_token(hashlib.sha256(token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(), now)
            self._respond(201, {"token": token, "created_at": format_ts(now)})
        elif name == "clock":
            self._set_clock(body)
        else:
            getattr(self, {"create": "_create_link", "list": "_list_links",
                           "get": "_get_link", "delete": "_delete_link",
                           "resolve": "_resolve"}[name])(now, token_hash, slug, body)

    def _set_clock(self, body):
        if set(body) != {"now"} or not isinstance(body["now"], str):
            raise ApiError(400, "invalid_request", 'body must be exactly {"now": ISO}')
        try:
            ts = parse_ts(body["now"])
        except ValueError:
            raise ApiError(400, "invalid_request", "invalid timestamp")
        self.server.clock.set(ts)
        self._respond(200, {"now": format_ts(ts)})

    # ---- link handlers: stubs until T4 ----
    def _not_implemented(self):
        raise ApiError(501, "internal", "not implemented")

    def _create_link(self, now, token_hash, slug, body):
        self._not_implemented()

        self._not_implemented()

    def _resolve(self, now, token_hash, slug, body):
        self._not_implemented()
